relevance_note: Two first-hand Danon disease patients with LAMP2 variants: 'The genetic analysis detected a pathogenic heterozygous mutation (c.973delC) in the LAMP2 gene' and 'A hemizygous nonsense mutation (c.35C>A) was identified in the LAMP2 gene of the patient'.
method_note: Built with a short Python script from my own reading; every span checked verbatim by script. Labels: the paper uses 'Patient I'/'Patient II' (Table 1 header and Figure 4, 4+ mentions each form incl. text) more often than 'Patient 1'/'Patient 2', so 'Patient I' and 'Patient II' are used. Table 1 has patients as columns (column headers 'Patient I' and 'Patient II'); lab-value spans quote the whole row, which includes the normal range; LDH, MBB and CK elevations are inferred from values above the printed normal range (MBB abbreviation is not defined). No stacked cells. Contradictions: Patient I's c.973delC is called 'heterozygous' in the case text but 'hemizygous' in the variant paragraph, so zygosity is 'not reported'; transcript NM_002294.2 (text) vs NM_002294 (Figure 4); protein p.Leu325TrpfsX21 (text) vs p.Leu325fs (Figure 4). Patient I inheritance recorded as de novo because both parents were tested and Figure 4 shows the site without mutation in father and mother (paper says 'assumed to be de novo'). 'Creatase' in the text read together with the Table 1 CK row. Patient I LVEF 34%/14.3% and Patient II LVEF 23% recorded as measurement rows; Patient I's reduced-EF checklist item left 'not reported' because the paper does not call the LVEF reduced; Patient II's item is observed from the stated 'dilated heart' including LV 57 mm. Patient I: 'No skeletal muscle strength ... abnormalities' not used to exclude the composite 'proximal muscle weakness (skeletal myopathy)' (biopsy shows vacuolar myopathy changes); 'no ... mental abnormalities' used to exclude the intellectual disability item only. Patient II's 'weakness' is unspecified and the referral to a Heart Failure Center was not taken as a heart-failure diagnosis. Relatives: father and mother of Patient I (tested, no variant; no variant rows); mother of Patient II (died of DCM, not tested) and grandfather of Patient II (died at 36 in unexplained circumstances, not tested; included as a relative described in relation to the patient). Literature persons included under the v4 in-passing rule: ref 18 patient (explanted heart, cardiomegaly, LVH), ref 23 patient (AF, thromboembolic stroke at 30), ref 14 family (three brothers and their mother, elevated cTnI; labelled ref 14 patient/2/3 and mother of ref 14 patient). Excluded: Antopol's two brothers (ref 12; Danon diagnosis only speculative), and all count-only statements (refs 7, 10, 11, 23, 24, 25, 34). Table S1 (literature studies) is not in the converted text.
